slides.text: Something happened during a live demo of a tool I built.

citations.quote: Something happened during a live demo of a tool I built

slides.text: I asked the tool for a five-second video. Nothing came back.

citations.quote: I asked the tool for a five-second video.

slides.text: A working demo proves the tool can work once, under conditions you controlled. A broken demo, left broken, proves something you can't fake.

citations.quote: A working demo proves the tool can work once, under conditions you controlled
A broken demo, left broken, proves something you can't fake

slides.text: Anyone can have a bug. What you can't manufacture after the fact is an honest reaction to one, on camera, in real time.
